subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.7.2-beta.5 gateway crash-loops when agent DB is still schema 14

question: For a managed gateway blocked by a required agent-database migration, should OpenClaw migrate before service startup, stop service retries until Doctor is run, or automatically clear the restart-loop suppression after a successful Doctor migration?
rationale: Each option changes the upgrade and operator contract differently; the report proves user harm but does not establish which recovery ownership model OpenClaw intends to support.

options.title: Stop deterministic retries and recover explicitly
options.body: Treat the migration-required error as non-retryable, direct the operator to Doctor, and provide a documented or visible restart/recovery action after migration.

options.title: Migrate before service startup
options.body: Add a bounded preflight migration path before LaunchAgent-managed gateway startup, with clear backup and failure reporting semantics.

options.title: Clear suppression after Doctor
options.body: Keep current startup validation but make successful Doctor migration clear only the related restart-loop state so normal account auto-start resumes immediately.

recommendation.title: Stop deterministic retries and recover explicitly
recommendation.body: Treat the migration-required error as non-retryable, direct the operator to Doctor, and provide a documented or visible restart/recovery action after migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context does not identify a repository code owner; the reporter can validate the real managed-upgrade behavior once an owner selects the intended contract.
